cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.text1: We approach cookies the same way we approach our cuts: with fewer ingredients and full transparency.
cookies.text2: We use our own and third-party cookies to improve your browsing experience, understand how the site is used and adapt content to your preferences. You can manage your settings or read more about them in our Cookies Policy.

modal.title: Cookie Settings
modal.intro: Our cuts are not an alternative, they're a choice. And we believe in informed choices. Below, you'll find a breakdown of the cookies we use and why we use them for.
modal.essential_desc: These are always active. They are strictly necessary for the site to function: storing your cookie preferences and protecting our contact forms against spam (Google reCAPTCHA).
modal.analytics_desc: They help us understand how visitors interact with the site by collecting anonymous usage data (Google Analytics).
modal.marketing_desc: They allow us to track leads and send relevant commercial communications based on your interactions with our site (HubSpot).
